title: Product listings expose both a sample price and zero-price items
observation: The captured Glucare Plus product page text presents a 1-package listing at 9,000 VND and other product listings at 0 VND in the same product section.

impact.user: A self-purchaser or adult child cannot tell from the captured state whether zero is a real price, unavailable price, or placeholder.
impact.business: Ambiguous price presentation can interrupt purchase confidence.

suggested_direction: Replace zero-price merchandising states with an explicit availability or contact-for-price label and keep package/price meaning consistent.
unknowns: The capture does not establish inventory, configuration, or backend pricing state.
persona_impact: Both an older self-purchaser and an adult child buying for a parent need an unambiguous package and payable price before proceeding.
limitations: Cart mutation and checkout were not performed; no payable total was observed.
